ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 65% low-intensity (black) and 35% high-intensity (white) pixels visible on the ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense high-intensity white mottling concentrated on outer lobes, transitioning to a dominant low-intensity black field in the central region; 2D mapping shows contiguous black central mass flanked by white marbling at the distal extremities.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate pixel angle of 105 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern visible along the entire trailing edge boundary with pixel-amplitude variations of 3 to 12 pixels relative to the water-edge interface.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward sweep on both lobes, terminating in sharp, tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized exclusively at the tips of both left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) concentrated on the medial-lateral section of the right lobe, with fewer scattered linear marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel linear scarring patterns (likely odontocete rake marks) visible on the pigmented surface of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique oval-shaped dark pixel boundary located within the white mottled region of the left lobe's mid-section.
